subject: pharmacology
title: Thyroid drugs: levothyroxine, antithyroids, storm and coma

steps.tx: **Levothyroxine** (T4 prohormone, narrow therapeutic index, **morning empty stomach** 30 to 60 minutes before food, **iron, calcium and PPI spacing** 4 hours, dose by weight with elderly and cardiac starting low) treats hypothyroidism to TSH normalisation; overreplacement fibrillates atria and thins bones. Amiodarone (iodine load, type I hyperthyroid versus type II destructive, beta blockade with steroids), lithium and TKIs disturb function requiring TSH watched. Myxoedema coma (hypothermia with bradycardia) loads IV.
steps.say: Empty stomach dawn thyroxine, minerals hours apart. Overreplace and atria fibrillate, bones thin.

steps.tx: **Antithyroids** (carbimazole or methimazole: **agranulocytosis** with sore throat warning and CBC, hepatotoxicity, teratogenic switching to **PTU first trimester**; PTU hepatotoxic second line) block synthesis (weeks to euthyroid, stores deplete slowly); **radioiodine** (definitive Graves, **pregnancy and breastfeeding banned**, ophthalmopathy worsening with steroids covered, lifelong hypothyroidism expected) and surgery (large goitre, cancer, second trimester pregnancy) complete. Beta blockers (propranolol) bridge symptoms and storm.
steps.say: Sore throat on carbimazole is agranulocytosis: CBC now. First trimester hyperthyroid is PTU; radioiodine never pregnant.

steps.tx: **Thyroid storm** (fever with agitation, tachycardia, heart failure, Burch-Wartofsky scoring) is cocktail treated: **PTU load** (blocks new synthesis plus T4 to T3 conversion), **iodine** (Lugol or SSKI an hour later blocking release), **steroids** (conversion blockade with adrenal support), **propranolol** (adrenergic storm), **cholestyramine** (enterohepatic recycling), cooling with fluids. ICU with trigger (infection, DKA, surgery) hunted; plasmapheresis refractory.
steps.say: Storm cooks agitated tachycardic: PTU, then iodine an hour later, steroids, propranolol. Iodine first traps hormone.

vis.alt: Diagram illustrating the multi-drug "cocktail" treatment for thyroid storm, including PTU, iodine, steroids, and propranolol.
vis.caption: Thyroid storm: Symptoms, triggers, and emergency cocktail treatment

steps.tx: **Myxoedema coma** (hypothermia, bradycardia, hypoventilation with hyponatraemia, precipitated by infection, sedatives, cold) is loaded IV thyroxine (**steroids before** covering adrenal insufficiency) with ventilation and warming (blankets, not aggressive); hyponatraemia fluids restrict. **Subclinical hypothyroidism** (TSH high, T4 normal) treats when over 10, pregnant, antibody positive or symptomatic; subclinical hyperthyroidism (low TSH) watches cardiac and bone. Amiodarone hypothyroidism replaces through.
steps.say: Cold slow comatose hypothyroid is myxoedema: steroids then IV thyroxine, warm gently. TSH over 10 treats.
